plan.name: Clear a stopped watcher's worktrees before polling
plan.summary: Clone gets ClearWorktrees, which force-removes every worktree registered in the clone other than the clone itself (the first one git lists), whether or not its directory still exists, and then runs git worktree prune. It joins the Repo interface. Before each poll, while it holds the lease, Watch calls ClearWorktrees: the clone is the watcher's own and polls run one at a time, so any worktree it finds is left over from a watcher that stopped mid-build. If clearing fails, Watch logs the error and skips that poll. A one-off run (-once) doesn't clear, since it may share a clone with a running watcher.

tests.name: TestClearWorktreesFreesALeftoverBranch
tests.says: Leftover worktrees in the clone, with or without their directories, are removed and pruned, so a new worktree can take their branches.

tests.name: TestWatchBuildsPastALeftoverWorktree
tests.says: With a leftover worktree holding an issue's branch, the watcher adds a worktree for that branch, builds, and opens the pull request.
